title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — October 06, 2026

Sunny is taking a closer look at NOAA Active Region 4549, where a sunspot region associated with recent M-class activity is showing up on the solar disk.

📍 Location: N10E01
☀️ Region: AR 4549
🔥 Recent activity: 2 M-class flares · 5 C-class flares

That is a lot of freckles. ☀️

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Image: N/A
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
